query: best workouts to do in conjunction with a pro hormone
plausible_answers: Heavy compound lifts (squat, deadlift, bench, OHP, row) in the 4-8 rep range on a 4-6 day split
High-volume hypertrophy work (8-12 reps, 15-20 sets per muscle / week)
Conservative training paired with on-cycle support and recovery emphasis
baseline_answer: Conservative training paired with on-cycle support and recovery emphasis
